title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Movistar Arena, Santiago | 2011
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Movistar Arena in Santiago, Chile, on 4 November 2011.

It was the 30th show of the 11th All-Starr Band’s tour of Europe and South America, which lasted for 39 dates between June and November 2011.

Starr returned to the Movistar Arena on 3 March 2015. Paul McCartney also played there on 22 and 23 April 2014.

The 11th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Wally Palmar: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Rick Derringer: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Gary Wright: vocals, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
